address: calle Tron, sestiere San Marco 1131, Venice, 30124, Italy
bio: Lagoon fusion cuisine at this historic restaurant just a few steps from St. Mark's: generous, colourful dishes prepared with great care and love for the local area, but without neglecting a few forays into the Orient, a passion of one of the two Venetian chefs. Dessert is highly recommended: especially the tiramisù! An excellent wine list, where you can find some rare vintage and collectible wines....
